decisions.reason: The existing message-595 MODIFY already establishes one randomly allocated ticket per no-referral primary mint; the primary-mint key excludes secondary sales, and accounting registration is represented by the ticket-accounting Requirements.

The existing message-595 MODIFY already records one ticket per eligible primary mint, inclusion of randomly allocated no-referral tickets, and required registration; secondary-sale ticket generation was already false.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already incorporates randomly allocated no-referral tickets into the eligible population and ticket-weighted selection rule.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already updates winner eligibility to include randomly allocated no-referral tickets from primary mints while excluding secondary-sale generation.
The FAQ already states that no-referral mints allocate a commission and ticket randomly, and message 595 does not necessarily require additional FAQ copy or invalidate its current content.
Message 595 changes commission issuance and accounting rules, not the existing $15 primary-mint revenue amounts or allocation buckets.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already requires displayed ticket totals to include randomly allocated no-referral tickets, reconcile to eligible primary mints, and exclude secondary sales.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already requires commission totals to include randomly issued commissions, reconcile to eligible primary mints, and exclude secondary sales.
The source concerns commissions allocated when no referral code is used; the direct-referral commission trigger, recipient, amount, and payout behavior remain unchanged.
Commission and ticket counting for primary mints does not change which referral codes are valid or the self-referral prevention rule.
The existing feedback already states that no or invalid codes route the commission and ticket randomly, and message 595 does not necessarily change the required feedback text.
Excluding secondary sales from generating new commissions and tickets does not prevent an already active ticket attached to an NFT from transferring with that NFT.
